description: Plan task U15 (replaces T112; re-added with only its real dependencies, owner-approved 2026-10-26). Follow docs/agent-work/2026-10-26-ui-wave-2/PLAN.md exactly: this task's section (Files, Interfaces, Steps, Acceptance check, Fail-first, Stop-and-ask, Default) plus the seven answered Open questions and the Notes for the implementer. handoff.text: REJECT (one narrow gap; everything else checks out). GAP: PLAN.md DoD line 39 requires unit tests showing page and every export give the same entries in the same order 'for each of the three orders and both scopes'. The only export-path test, src/research/bibliography.test.ts:229-273, hard-codes bibliographyScope: "cited" (line 243), so scope 'all' never goes through Markdown, plain text or documentBlocks. Proven: mutation M5 (textExport.ts passes only {bibliographyOrder} to bibliographyItems, dropping scope) SURVIVES npx vitest run src/research src/export (355/355 pass). U15 Step 4 (line 394) only listed three orders, so this is a plan-internal gap, not sloppiness. FIX: in that test wrap the body in a second loop over scopes ["cited","all"] and set bibliographyScope: scope (expected is already derived from project.documentSettings, so MD, plain-text and documentBlocks assertions generalize); confirm M5 then fails. Optional, non-blocking: add a fixture footnote that exists in research.footnotes but has no marker, citing an uncited source, and assert it stays out of cited scope (my M7 'cited set = any footnote' was caught only incidentally by an unrelated PDF font test in document.test.ts). CHECKED AND ACCEPTED: Interfaces match U15 exactly (types.ts optional bibliographyOrder/Scope; BibliographyOrder/Scope/Item types, SOURCE_KIND_HEADINGS, citedSourceOrder, bibliographyItems signatures; heading ids 'heading:'+kind). Rules per Step 1 incl. cited-order+all-scope tail in author order; module comment cites no CMOS paragraphs. One function used by documentBlocks (document.ts:288), Markdown (### headings, - entries) and plain text (textExport.ts:185,270); DOCX/PDF consume d.bibliography with bold heading items per Step 3; nativePdf.ts untouched. Cited-set semantics unified on footnoteIdsInOrder (referenced markers only), matching the two legacy export paths; only the old ResearchPanel any-footnote path differed. Back-compat: 'absent settings equal author/cited' test; author-order text equals legacy bibliography() for cited set; defaultDocumentSettings unchanged; no TS validator to update; Rust stores documentSettings opaquely. Tests living in bibliography.test.ts instead of document/textExport.test.ts: acceptable. ResearchPanel optional bibliography prop unwired: App.tsx not in U15 Files but is in U16 Files (ResearchPanel props :2256-2270), so U16 must pass bibliographyItems(project, project.documentSettings); until then the panel keeps the legacy any-footnote list (known interim state). Minor non-blocking: an unknown future bibliographyOrder string yields an empty bibliography (bibliography.ts final return []). M6 (DOCX/PDF ignore heading flag) survives unit tests but order/entries are still covered via documentBlocks equality; bold rendering verified in artifacts. RUNS (pinned Node 22.23.3, slot unowned): tsc --noEmit 0 errors; vitest src/research src/export 18 files/355 pass; full npm test --no-file-parallelism --maxWorkers=1 53 files/913 pass, whole 14-line log read, no fail/skip (ui2-u15-review/unit.log). FAIL-FIRST on scratch copy outside project: M1 ignore order -> 3 fail; M2 ignore scope -> 1 fail; M3 HEAD textExport.ts -> export test fails; M7 killed incidentally; M5 and M6 survive. ARTIFACTS viewed: ui2-u15/type.md, pdftotext type.pdf, unzip word/document.xml of type.docx -> identical Books/Journal articles/Websites order with author order inside; p-2.png read (bold headings, entries, page 2). Fixture author inversion 'Alice, Alpha,.' is fixture data, same as legacy.
